project_type: Full-stack SaaS Educational Management System (Node.js/Express + React/Next.js + PostgreSQL/Prisma)
build_system: npm/pnpm with Next.js build system for frontend, ts-node/tsc for backend
test_framework: Jest for unit tests, with potential for Playwright/Cypress for E2E
verification_instructions:
1. Run npm install in /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app
2. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation
3. Run npm test to verify tests pass
4. Verify Prisma schema validates with npx prisma validate
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated files (node_modules/.prisma/client). Regenerate with: npx prisma generate
setup_instructions:
1. cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app
2. npm install
3. npx prisma generate
4. npm run build
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Node.js v22 available with npm/pnpm/yarn. PostgreSQL is NOT pre-installed but Prisma schema can be generated and validated. TypeScript available globally.
contribution_requirements: This is a greenfield project being built from scratch based on legacy system screenshots. All modules from the legacy system must be replicated with 100% operational fidelity. Only the visual interface may be modernized.
key_patterns: Monorepo structure with /app directory containing both backend API and frontend. Prisma ORM for database schema. Express.js REST API backend. Next.js React frontend with modern UI (dark/light mode, sidebar navigation, dashboard). JWT authentication with refresh tokens. Multi-tenant (multi-company, multi-unit) architecture.
directory_structure:
/projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/ - Repository root
/projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/extracted_images/ - 92 screenshots from legacy system
/projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/ - New SaaS application (to be created)
  /app/prisma/ - Prisma schema and migrations
  /app/src/ - Source code
    /app/src/backend/ - Express.js API
    /app/src/frontend/ - Next.js React app
    /app/src/shared/ - Shared types and utilities
